english.note: Use 等於 as the all-purpose verb when something has the same value or amounts to the same consequence.
Use 等於 when one thing is exactly equivalent to or has the same value as another.
Use this for arithmetic or other statements that one quantity adds up to or amounts to another.

examples.english: Five kilograms equal five thousand grams.
examples.jyutping: ng5 gung1 gan1 dang2 jyu1 ng5 cin1 hak1

examples.english: Ten ten-dollar bills correspond to one hundred dollars.
examples.traditional: 十張十蚊紙等於一百蚊。
examples.jyutping: sap6 zoeng1 sap6 man1 zi2 dang2 jyu1 jat1 baak3 man1

examples.english: Three plus two make a total of five.
examples.jyutping: saam1 gaa1 ji6 dang2 jyu1 ng5
